card: Choose the WooCommerce modules your store needs.
title: Empora for a WooCommerce store
intro: Empora puts store tools in one WordPress plugin. A merchant chooses the modules to turn on, instead of carrying every option into the shop.

sections.heading: What does Empora bring together?
sections.body: Store functions sit together in one WooCommerce WordPress plugin.

sections.heading: Can a merchant choose modules?
sections.body: A merchant switches on the modules the shop needs. The rest can stay off.

sections.heading: What does its dashboard handle?
sections.body: The web dashboard covers licences and optional connections to stores.

sections.heading: Where does Empora fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell is a personal place for people and moments. Empora has a different desk: a merchant choosing tools for a WooCommerce store.
